subject: Proposal: Rolling credit ladder and VAT holdback integration for Q4 billing
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearbuilt.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearbuilt.com, marco.deluca@clearbuilt.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing cadence + VAT holdback question

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profiles. Procurement asked me to confirm billing cadence and how you handle EU VAT evidence. For our pilot (est. $12–15k/mo) we need two things clarified before we raise a PO: 1) Can Redwood accept Net45 for the pilot and 2) do you apply any VAT holdback while we provide VAT registration docs? Our legal ops prefers Net45 but finance is open to a small retention until VAT paperwork is completed.

Attach: ClearBuilt_Demand_Runbook.pdf (pdf)

Would appreciate a short note on options and any impact to unit pricing.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform Partnerships
ClearBuilt Health
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearbuilt.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, k arthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@clearbuilt.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence + VAT holdback question

Hi Elena — really glad the demo landed well. Quick summary of options from our side so procurement has text for the PO: 

Option A — Conditional Net45 (recommended for pilot)
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly in arrears, invoices due 45 days.
- Credit cap: $50k for the pilot period, auto-review at end of month 2.
- VAT: We invoice gross to your EU entity; Redwood holds a 10% VAT retention on each invoice until you provide VAT registration and a valid VAT number. Retention is released within 10 business days of validated docs.
- Pricing: No change for Net45 + retention.

Option B — Net30 with no retention (if procurement prefers no holdback)
- Requires a company guarantee or a 30-day pre-funded invoice to remove the VAT retention. Small surcharge of 2% on monthly invoice to cover short-term credit risk.

I'll loop in Finance for one-line confirmation on the credit cap and PO wording. Attached is a draft SOW clause we typically include for rolling-credit ladder and retention.

Next steps: let me know which option procurement prefers and we can circulate PO language and a DocuSign for the SOW addendum.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-draft-sow-v2.docx]
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearbuilt.com>
Cc: k arthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@clearbuilt.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence + VAT holdback question

Elena / Team — adding a few operational details so procurement has everything for the PO: 

- Invoice schedule: We will send invoices on the 3rd business day after month close (e.g., Nov invoice sent Dec 3).
- Bill-to: Please confirm which legal entity we should bill (ClearBuilt Health GmbH vs ClearBuilt Global Ltd). Billing entity affects VAT treatment.
- PO text suggestion: "Redwood Inference to invoice monthly in arrears. Payments due within 45 days of invoice date. Redwood may retain up to 10% of invoiced amount as VAT holdback pending receipt of valid EU VAT registration and documentation. Retained amounts will be released within 10 business days of validation."

I've also attached our sample invoice template so procurement knows the line items we include.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Finance — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-invoice-template.xlsx]
From: procurement@clearbuilt.com <procurement@clearbuilt.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearbuilt.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence + VAT holdback question

Hi all — procurement here. Two quick items from our side: 

1) We will raise PO for Net45 as long as the retention clause is included verbatim (we need the legal text — see below).
2) ClearBuilt Health GmbH will be the billed entity (registered in DE). We acknowledge VAT retention and will provide VAT registration docs within 14 days of PO.

Legal text requested for PO: "Redwood Inference may withhold up to 10% of the invoiced amount for VAT reconciliation when billing an EU entity. Withheld amounts will be reconciled and released within 10 business days following receipt of valid VAT registration documentation."

Also — to confirm credit: is the $50k pilot credit cap a hard stop or an automatic temporary uplift with notification? Procurement prefers an automatic uplift + approval workflow rather than an immediate stop.

Regards,
Marco DeLuca
Procurement Lead — ClearBuilt Health
From: k arthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence + VAT holdback question

Jonas / Marissa — finance confirming operational behavior: 

- $50k pilot credit cap will be enforced as a soft cap: at 90% utilization the system fires an automated alert to the sales and finance owners and procurement; an automated temporary uplift (+25% of cap) can be approved by Finance Ops via the Redwood Console (email approval sufficient for pilots).
- Retention accounting: we will record a receivable against the retention line item and release it upon validating VAT docs. No impact to invoices other than the withheld line item.
- If ClearBuilt provides a company guarantee or prefunding, Finance Ops can remove the retention entirely.

I'll draft the exact PO wording but the language Marco requested is fine.

Karthik Iyer
Finance Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearbuilt.com>, procurement@clearbuilt.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, k arthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence + VAT holdback question

Thanks everyone — quick wrap and action items: 

- ClearBuilt confirms billed entity: ClearBuilt Health GmbH.
- Redwoods confirms Option A (Conditional Net45 + 10% VAT retention; $50k soft cap with automated uplift path).
- Action: Procurement to send PO with agreed clause (Marco).
- Action: Elena to upload VAT registration to the shared Drive folder linked below; Finance will validate and release retention within 10 business days post-validation.
- Action: I will push the SOW addendum to DocuSign and include the credit-ladder paragraph. Link: https://www.docusign.com/transactions/abc-987

If procurement wants the retention removed immediately, they can request a company guarantee or prepay first invoice (we listed the surcharge for Net30 removal earlier). Otherwise we'll proceed with Net45 + retention.

Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
